compiler.intent_brief.inputs: The operator’s request and supplied evidence, including the known model, workload, device, budget and policy constraints.
compiler.intent_brief.outputs: A validated intent record and a reviewable brief that identifies the requested outcome, the source of each constraint, unresolved questions and the review decision.

compiler.engine_contract.inputs: The reviewed intent brief, system ontology, verified checkpoint facts and target device profile.
compiler.engine_contract.outputs: A versioned engine contract linking interfaces, resource budgets, permitted choices and acceptance gates to their sources, or a set of conflicts returned for review.

factory.workflow_planning.inputs: The approved engine contract, system ontology, available builder capabilities, target topology, source inventory and current evidence, including any collected results from earlier attempts.
factory.workflow_planning.outputs: An inventory of verified capabilities and gaps, plus work orders that name the assigned CCs, input artifacts, providers, completion checks and retry decisions.

factory.source_integration.inputs: An authorized source tree or starter workspace, an assigned component change, its interface contract and the required dependency revisions.
factory.source_integration.outputs: A reviewable patch, candidate source revision, test evidence and a build request identifying the candidate and its prerequisites.

factory.builder.inputs: A reviewed candidate source revision, build contract, pinned dependencies and toolchain, and the target configuration.
factory.builder.outputs: A collected build result linking the completed attempt to the source revision, image and archive digests, build manifest and logs.

factory.controlled_experiment.inputs: The collected candidate image and baseline identities, checkpoint and workload revisions, contract gates, target, controls, resource budget and numerical reference.
factory.controlled_experiment.outputs: A trial manifest, observed quality and performance, resource measurements and a scoped pass, fail or inconclusive verdict with reproduction records.
